ec: Update U2F_ATTEST function for new-style key handles. The existing implementation of this function was intended for old-style key handles, and needs to be replaced with a new implementation for new-style key handles that incorporate user secrets. For bonus points, the existing implementatation is actually broken, and performs no verification, so will blindly attest to anything, which is Not Good. media-libs/libva-amdgpu-driver: Backport one fix patch for vaDeriveImage() Since AMD driver doesn't support vaDeriveImage() on contigous planes, it fallbacks to vaCreateImage()+vaPutImage(). vaDeriveImage should return VA_STATUS_ERROR_OPERATION_FAILED in the case, according to the VA-API specification [1]. We need to do the fallback in Chromium code (see crrev.com/c/1437634). However, AMD driver doesn't follow the specification. So that Chromium handle the proper fallback behavior, we shall apply the AMD driver fix patch into libva-amdgpu-driver. The original patch has been merged in master branch in mesa project [2]. [1] http://01org.github.io/libva_staging_doxygen/group__api__core.html#gaaddbbd4c6ea5bcfe928adc991cc5faab [2] https://cgit.freedesktop.org/mesa/mesa/commit/?id=2cf2a5673995e61de5943d502d1b29102e16cd5c BUG=b:73436929 TEST=emerge-grunt libva-amdgpu-driver TEST=vaDeriveImage() returns VA_STATUS_ERROR_OPERATION_FAILED (with crrev.com/c/1377754 and crrev.com/c/1437634) Change-Id: Ic8da012f0912e02cdfd462b5e74adf70704a33dd Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1469881 Commit-Ready: Hirokazu Honda <hiroh@chromium.org> Tested-by: Hirokazu Honda <hiroh@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Drew Davenport <ddavenport@chromium.org>
